A polished game screenshot target, not a flat cartoon painting. Preserve the uncluttered central path. No black outlines, no realism, no grit, no dramatic darkness, no added obstacles, no branding, no text, no watermarks. The shot is 'Market welcome': a delightful sunny arrival to this seafront town.
